x: The Youth's 5,000m gave us our best result with Richard Dorman taking second place to Gordon Vale (Surrey W.C.) in 25:13. The aforementioned Trevor was 11th in 26:44 with Peter Morris 18th in 28:37.
On a cold evening those who braved the conditions saw Gordon Vale of Surrey leave Carl Lawton standing as he broke the British Junior Record with 44m.41.6.

The first home was last years runner up, Allan King of Leicester, then came Gordon Vale, Surrey Walking Club's rising star. In third place came Belgrave's rising star Richard Dorman, beating for the first time Carl Lawton, winner on no less than 5 occasions, who was two seconds behind for 5th.

In a repeat clash of the three leading British Juniors, Richard Dorman beat his personal best,but in a close race was beaten into third place. 1.G.Vale (S.W.C.) 12.42; 2.I.McCombie (North Shields) 12.49; 3.R.Dorman 12.51.
Gordon Vale and the much improved Phil Vesty of Leicester with Mike Nicholls and Stephen Marshall backing up it was the Belgrave Title again.

1.M.Parker (Br.) 42.17.9; 2.G.Vale (SWC) 42.33.83; C.Lawton 44.28.5 5.R.Dorman 45.30.9; 10.J.Newnham 49.13.4. APRIL 25th 1981 - HAYES, KENT - S.A.R.W.A. 20 MILES CHAMPIONSHIP WITH BELGRAVE AND SURREY COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIP IN CONJUNCTION
